backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko canister actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report listing UX, audio, and visual updates tied to HugDayExperience.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files and their roles in the Hug Day experience.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme with color tokens, dark mode variables, and global border/background utilities.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the SPA root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Renders the HugDayExperience component as the app root.
frontend/src/components/HugDayExperience: Implements landing and reveal phases with animations, hero image, audio playback logic, and UI transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, login/logout handling, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Romantic-themed Tailwind styles with fonts, color variables, dark mode, and animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Defines Tailwind configuration with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, issues, and image editing tasks for a two-phase romantic Hug Day web experience.
